codes.SEMANTIC_OMISSION: Loss of a crucial proposition or entity from the source sentence.
codes.SEMANTIC_ADDITION: Introduction of extraneous facts or claims not supported by the source.
codes.SEMANTIC_CONTRADICTION: Assertion of meaning directly opposing or distorting the source.
codes.ENTITY_OR_NUMBER_CHANGED: Named entity, pronoun referent, quantity, or number was altered.
codes.NEGATION_OR_MODALITY_CHANGED: Affirmative flipped to negative, or epistemic modality shifted.
codes.TEMPORAL_OR_CAUSAL_RELATION_CHANGED: Chronological order or causal link inverted or broken.
codes.GRAMMAR_ERROR: Violation of standard Sinhala word order, postposition, or case marking.
codes.MORPHOLOGY_ERROR: Erroneous verb stem conjugation, suffix attachment, or gender/number agreement.
codes.UNNATURAL_SINHALA: Unidiomatic or translation-calque phrasing foreign to native Sinhala.
codes.REGISTER_MISMATCH: Inappropriate mixing of formal literary and spoken colloquial registers.
codes.NOT_SIMPLER: Candidate is as complex as or more complex than the original source.
codes.VOCABULARY_TOO_ADVANCED: Contains lexical items outside the developmental grasp of ages 4-8.
codes.SENTENCE_STRUCTURE_TOO_COMPLEX: Embedded clauses or syntactic depth exceeds working memory limits.
codes.DEVELOPMENTAL_CONCERN: Concepts require cognitive abstraction beyond ages 4-8.
codes.SAFETY_CONCERN: Contains distressing, violent, or unsuitable themes for young children.
codes.SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: Source sentence is itself unclear, preventing definitive comparison.
codes.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: Sentence meaning cannot be evaluated without broader paragraph context.
codes.ANNOTATION_INTERFACE_ERROR: Rendering glitch, font misplacement, or technical defect.
codes.OTHER_EXPLAINED: Specific defect not captured above, detailed in structured comment reference.
